faq.question: What tests are included in the Health Package 4999?
faq.answer: The package includes complete blood profile, sugar tests, cardiac screening, liver function tests, and a doctor summary consultation.

faq.question: Is this package available at all OMNI Hospitals branches?
faq.answer: The Health Package 4999 is available at selected OMNI Hospitals branches. Submit an enquiry to confirm availability at your nearest branch.

faq.question: How long does the health checkup take?
faq.answer: The screening typically takes 2–3 hours depending on the tests. Results and doctor consultation are usually completed the same day.
